asmc.observation: Dry conditions persisted over many parts of the southern ASEAN region overnight, apart from showers mainly over the northern parts of Sumatra, and parts of Borneo. Scattered to widespread hotspots were detected in Kalimantan and the southern parts of Sumatra, while few to isolated hotspots were detected elsewhere in the southern ASEAN region. Moderate to dense transboundary smoke haze was observed over parts of Peninsular Malaysia, Kalimantan, Sumatra, and the western parts of Sarawak. Moderate to dense smoke haze was also observed over Papua, the Maluku Islands and Sulawesi. Several air quality stations in Peninsular Malaysia recorded Unhealthy levels, while some stations in Kalimantan and Sumatra reported Unhealthy to Hazardous levels. The full extent of the hotspot situation over Kalimantan and Sumatra could not be determined due to obscuration by thick smoke haze and cloud cover, while the smoke haze situation over parts of the region could not be fully determined due to cloud cover.   Dry weather prevailed over the northern ASEAN region overnight, except over the southern parts of the Mekong sub-region where there were showers. Hotspot and smoke haze activities remained subdued.
